description: After the human approved on Moltbound's website (or via moltbound_human_sim_approve): complete the fictional purchase within 15 minutes. Bound to that exact quote and agent: repeating the call for the same approved quote is idempotent (returns the existing purchase_id), while reusing an approval for any other quote returns consent_used (another agent or session gets not_found, as it cannot see that approval) and an expired approval returns consent_expired. SANDBOX: use fictitious data only. Do not enter real personal details.
name: moltbound_complete_purchase
